get.summary: Returns liveness status of the backend process.
Returns readiness status once initialization is complete.
Returns typed system status for the frontend walking skeleton.

post.summary: Triggers a refresh cycle across all registered data sources and returns the resulting status.

get.summary: Returns the saved workspace list and any nonfatal configuration warning.

post.summary: Creates and persists a new workspace configuration.

delete.summary: Removes all workspace configuration and returns to the empty startup state.

put.summary: Updates and persists an existing workspace configuration.

delete.summary: Permanently deletes a workspace assignment from configuration.

post.summary: Archives a workspace so it no longer appears as an active tab (isEnabled = false).
Restores a previously archived workspace (isEnabled = true).

put.summary: Persists a new tab order for the currently active (enabled) workspaces.

get.summary: Returns the current user preferences and any nonfatal configuration warning.

put.summary: Validates and persists updated user preferences.

get.summary: Returns the projected MPS dashboard for a workspace, auto-loading from QAD on first access.

post.summary: Forces one reload of MPS source facts from QAD for the workspace and returns the projected dashboard.

get.summary: Returns lazily-loaded Part Info for a workspace's selected MPS parent part.
Returns the eligible (Allocating/Frozen/Released) work orders for one MPS bucket.
Returns lazily-loaded material/kitting lines and Kitting Summary for one work order.
Returns candidate subassembly work orders for a manufactured component, across all eligible A/F/R work orders regardless of Due Date.
Returns the scheduler-visible current-effective BOM for a workspace's selected MPS parent part, enriched with shared Site + Part inventory.
Returns lazily-loaded Component Detail (master, selected-site planning, Standard Cost, QCTC, shared Site + Part inventory) for a workspace-selected component part.
Returns the lazily-loaded Approved Vendor List (AVL) for a workspace-selected component part.
